judge.rationale: The candidate implemented the wrong wire protocol names and TypeScript types (`list_sessions`, `session_list`, `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame` with a `sessions` array) instead of the explicitly specified `list_conversations`, `conversation_list`, `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, and `ConversationSummary` with `conversations`. Because the public API and wire protocol names are completely wrong, it fails the primary acceptance criteria and would break any client built against the spec. Additionally, the candidate missed adding the `StoreCannotList` error class, omitted the `§ Conversation List` section in `docs/getting-started.md`, and polluted the diff by reformatting unrelated markdown files and modifying `scripts/check-doc-blocks.mjs`. On the positive side, the candidate did correctly wire `transport.history.enabled`, handle the request off the turn lock, validate the composite `before` cursor and 200-item `limit`, and warn when history is enabled without resume.
